name: Big-Math-RL-Verified-zhtw
description: A Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) verified subset of the Big-Math benchmark designed to evaluate mathematical problem solving in Chinese. It contains diverse math problems (arithmetic, algebra, calculus, reasoning) presented in zh-TW, with answers verified via RL-style procedures. The benchmark measures a model's ability to produce correct final answers in natural-language/math form.
reputation: Part of the Big-Math family; of niche interest for Chinese-language math evaluation and cited by researchers working on multilingual math solving.
